papers.title_en: Rethinking ANNS on Commodity PIM: PIM-Native Vector Search with Cooperative Filtering
papers.authors: Dawei Guo, Yizou Chen, Fan Yang, Hui Li, Ming-Chang Yang
papers.evidence: 基于二值量化的PIM原生近似最近邻向量检索
papers.tldr: ANNS的向量扫描阶段受内存带宽限制，PIM被视为有前景的加速平台，但现有PIM方案多把CPU式距离计算和top-k选择直接搬到PIM，算术与状态开销过重，难以匹配轻量且隔离的PIM核。PIVOT提出PIM原生向量搜索：用二值量化重构PIM端距离评估，以位运算实现免查找表计算；并用幸存质量模型导出保守阈值，在CPU端做簇过滤、PIM端做下界过滤与协作筛选，消除逐核top-k状态。系统将查询全局协调与重排留在CPU，把访存密集、数据并行的过滤下沉PIM，并通过配置专用内核和跨查询批次流水线提升利用率。在真实UPMEM上，PIVOT过滤掉99.3%–99.7%探测向量，QPS最高达CPU基线的18.8倍、先前PIM基线的10.2倍，召回率更高，适用于高维嵌入。
papers.abstract_en: Approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) is a key primitive in modern data-intensive systems, and its memory-bound vector-scanning stage makes processing-in-memory (PIM) a promising acceleration platform. Existing PIM-based ANNS systems largely transplant CPU-oriented distance evaluation and top-$k$ selection onto PIM, introducing arithmetic- and state-heavy operations that poorly match lightweight, isolated PIM cores. To address these mismatches, we present PIVOT, a PIM-native vector search system with cooperative filtering, which thoroughly rethinks how ANNS should be executed on commodity PIM. First, PIVOT recasts PIM-side distance evaluation around binary quantization to exploit PIM-native bitwise operations, enabling LUT-free evaluation with low arithmetic cost and a small local-memory footprint. Second, PIVOT redesigns PIM-side candidate selection around threshold-guided cooperative filtering, using a survivor-mass model to derive a conservative threshold for CPU-side cluster filtering and PIM-side lower-bound filtering, thereby reducing output traffic and eliminating per-core top-$k$ state. PIVOT organizes these stages into a cooperative workflow that keeps query-global coordination and reranking on the CPU while assigning memory-intensive, data-parallel filtering to PIM. To efficiently realize this workflow and sustain high utilization across devices, PIVOT further generates configuration-specialized PIM kernels and pipelines CPU-side preparation and reranking with PIM-side filtering across query batches. Evaluations on real UPMEM hardware show that PIVOT filters out 99.3-99.7% of probed vectors and achieves up to $18.8\times$ and $10.2\times$ the QPS of CPU and prior PIM baselines, respectively. PIVOT also achieves higher recall than existing PIM systems and remains effective on high-dimensional embeddings.

papers.title_en: SJG: A Skyline Joint Graph for Multi-Component Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
papers.authors: Linyun Ma, Rui Mao
papers.evidence: 面向多组件近似最近邻搜索的联合近邻图索引
papers.tldr: 面向多组件近似最近邻搜索时，查询权重在建图阶段未知，按组件分别建索引再合并结果容易漏掉加权距离下的真正最近邻，而联合图又存在冗余边和层级同步限制。本文提出Skyline Joint Graph（SJG），利用候选邻居间的支配关系不随查询权重改变这一性质，跨组件汇总候选并只保留每个节点的Skyline。实验在六个真实数据集上显示，90% Recall@10时查询吞吐最高达基线的27.9倍，单线程建索引加速最高201倍，索引空间至少比最小基线少36%。
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based indexes enable efficient approximate nearest neighbor search at scale by linking similar objects. In applications such as product retrieval and rental listing search, similarity depends on several components whose relative importance varies across queries. The challenge is that the index must select neighbors during construction, but the query weights that determine which objects are closest are not yet known. A straightforward approach is to index each component separately. However, merging the results of these searches can miss the nearest neighbor under the weighted distance. A joint graph allows a search to follow links across components, helping to avoid such misses, but selecting neighbors separately within each component can leave redundant edges, and keeping component hierarchies synchronized limits parallel construction. To address these limitations, we propose the Skyline Joint Graph (SJG). Although query weights can change the ranking of candidate neighbors, the dominance relation among them is independent of those weights. SJG exploits this property by pooling candidates across components and retaining the Skyline for each node, thereby enabling efficient approximate nearest neighbor search under different query weights while supporting parallel graph construction. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets demonstrate that SJG achieves up to $27.9\times$ the query throughput of baseline methods at 90% Recall@10, while accelerating single-threaded index construction by up to $201\times$. Its index requires at least 36% less space than the smallest baseline index.

papers.title_en: OpenMAS-GApp: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Domain-Adaptive Multi-Agent Application Construction
papers.authors: Xunkai Li, Kairui Yang, Jiaxi Li, Yuecong Mao, Zekai Chen, Xinle Zhang, Rong-Hua Li, Guoren Wang
papers.evidence: 面向多智能体应用构建的综合基准
papers.tldr: 多智能体系统应用构建需将多样需求转化为可执行系统，但现有智能体生成、架构设计、工作流生成与组件选择等研究各自独立评估，任务规格与执行环境不统一，难以横向比较。为此提出OpenMAS-GApp跨领域统一基准，标准化任务输入、组件资源、构建接口与执行环境。其Graph Harness参考方法可从任务依赖推导出发，选择兼容的智能体与工具并组织为可执行图。最终在19个数据集、20种评估设置下覆盖4类应用与4个专业领域开展评测。
papers.abstract_en: Constructing multi-agent system (MAS) applications across domains requires translating diverse requirements into executable systems, involving task decomposition, agent and tool selection, and execution organization. Existing studies have explored individual aspects of MAS construction, including agent generation, architecture design, workflow generation, and component selection. However, these methods are often developed and evaluated independently, using different task specifications, component resources, and execution settings. This makes it difficult to compare their construction capabilities or determine how they can be applied to different domains. To address this problem, we propose OpenMAS-GApp, a One-for-All benchmark for MAS application construction across diverse domains. It standardizes task inputs, component resources, construction interfaces, and execution environments to support MAS construction under consistent conditions. Within OpenMAS-GApp, we provide Graph Harness as a reference construction method that derives task dependencies, selects compatible agents and tools, and organizes their interactions into executable graphs. We evaluate construction methods across 19 benchmark datasets under 20 evaluation settings spanning four application types and four professional domains.

papers.title_en: Moving Generality from Model to Modeler: LLM Agents for PHM on a Deployment-Style Benchmark
papers.authors: Zhenling Chen, Zhiguo Zeng, Anne Barros
papers.evidence: 以部署式基准评测自主大模型编码智能体在留出单元上的表现
papers.tldr: 在PHM中，模型必须泛化到未见设备。作者主张把泛化能力从模型转向“建模者”，让LLM智能体在NextUnit-Bench部署式基准上为每个新任务现场设计可执行预测器；该基准含24个公开数据集、58个折，要求两小时内交付。实验表明前沿智能体大幅优于AutoML和多数复现方法，优势主要来自针对具体机器数据的设计，几百字文本计划即可传递大部分差距。但强设计只有强执行者能落地，开放权重模型仅约一半场景可用。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs) now help develop many models published as general solutions. Should generality instead reside in the agent that builds a model for each new task? We examine this question in prognostics and health management (PHM), where every model must work on unseen equipment. Our deployment-style benchmark, NextUnit-Bench, covers 24 public datasets split into 58 folds that hold out units or operating conditions; each agent has two hours to deliver an executable predictor, then run on the hidden units. First, frontier agents outperform AutoML, which reaches less than half the best agent's score, and faithful implementations of published methods on four datasets, of which only 6 of 30 beat the strongest agent's own design; published accuracies, where reproducible, rest on the papers' own conventions, and a single convention, capping the remaining life of test engines, can halve the reported error. Second, the agents' advantage is a design made on each machine's data; once made, a plain-text plan of a few hundred words carries most of the gap between two frontier agents, and given a weaker agent's plan, the strongest agent falls to that agent's level, often to identical predictions. Before touching the data, however, it matters little whose plan an agent carries out, and domain toolkits appear to help neither: what sets the strongest apart is how much it learns from the data. Third, such designs reach only implementers that can execute them: given the strongest agent's designs, a locally deployable open-weight model delivers half as often, even when they are lightened, and scores no higher than without them. Generality, we argue, is not disappearing but moving, from the model to the modeler.

papers.title_en: EA-Bench: Measuring information and action efficiency under imperfect instructions
papers.authors: Xu Wan, Wenyue Xu, Shenjie Zhao
papers.evidence: 评估智能体工具调用与交互效率的基准
papers.tldr: 现有个人智能体基准多假设用户信息充分，但真实任务常含缺失、冗余或冲突信息。EA-Bench 将工作流建模为 DAG，按节点依赖设计扰动，并用 AI 加专家两阶段筛选出 232 个条件、划分 Easy/Hard。实验显示不完美信息会降低准确率并抬高工具调用与用户交互成本。该基准首次联合评估两类效率，并揭示模型未经确认猜测用户特定值的不可靠执行风险。
papers.abstract_en: Personal agents help users complete everyday work across digital applications. Many standard benchmarks assume that users provide sufficient information to solve a task. However, agents often encounter incomplete, distracting, or inconsistent information in practice. To systematically study agent inefficiency under such imperfect information, we introduce Efficient Action (EA)-Bench, which evaluates both tool calls and user interactions in work-related tasks. To our knowledge, it is the first benchmark to jointly evaluate tool-call efficiency and user-interaction efficiency under controlled missing, redundant, and conflicting information. We construct 63 base-task instances adapted from existing work-related benchmarks. To guide perturbation design and quantify task requirements, we represent workflows as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and examine node-level dependencies to identify where information can be withheld, contradicted, or supplemented with distractors. We use a two-stage validation process combining AI-assisted checks with expert screening to select 232 conditions from 792 initial candidates. We organize these tasks into Easy and Hard tracks by task complexity. Experiments show that imperfect information can reduce accuracy and increase tool-use and user-interaction costs. More concerning, several models obtain apparently correct outcomes by guessing user-specific values without confirmation, revealing potential execution unreliability in current models under imperfect user information.

papers.title_en: Zarc: Exact Nearest Neighbors over a Billion Vectors in Seconds
papers.authors: Dongfang Zhao
papers.evidence: 十亿级向量的精确最近邻检索
papers.tldr: 精确 k 近邻搜索是 LLM 稀疏注意力、长上下文和训练去重的关键路径，但全量 GPU 扫描慢、近似索引不精确。Zarc 只把半精度距离证明的短行留在 GPU 内存，再从主机内存取回少量完整向量，在更新下精确支持欧氏、余弦、内积和过滤查询。4 块 H100 上，十亿向量的一万条精确查询从约五分钟降至 1.1 秒，11 个开源 LLM 上加速 2.2–13.1 倍。它为十亿级精确向量检索提供了可落地方案。
papers.abstract_en: Exact k-nearest-neighbor vector search lies on the critical path of machine learning systems, from sparse attention in the latest large language models (LLMs) to long-context memories and training-data deduplication. Exhaustive GPU search scans the whole dataset for every query, while approximate indexes return inexact neighbors. Recent methods skip almost every vector with a cheap half-precision proof that it lies too far away, but only on one GPU that holds the whole dataset. Our insight is to keep only the short rows of these proofs in GPU memory and to fetch the few remaining full vectors from host memory. Our system, Zarc, answers Euclidean, cosine, inner-product, and filtered queries exactly under updates. On four H100 GPUs, it answers 10,000 exact queries over one billion vectors in 1.1 seconds instead of five minutes. On eleven open LLMs, it retrieves the exact top-10 attention keys 2.2x to 13.1x faster than exhaustive search. In sparse attention over one million tokens, it runs 3.1x faster than bf16 selection with FlashInfer, which misses the exact top-64 for most queries.

papers.title_en: Tracking Representations in LLM Reasoning Traces for Iterated Games
papers.authors: Chaipat Tirapongprasert, Rajarshi Das, Parijat Dube
papers.evidence: 分析迭代博弈中LLM的推理轨迹
papers.tldr: LLM智能体常用思维链推理，但外部推理轨迹与内部计算的关系仍不清楚。本文以不完全信息迭代博弈为场景，结合多种机制可解释性技术追踪模型决策。研究发现模型会在思维链中形成并反复修正游戏内部表示，一旦过早固守错误信念便很难纠正，且该失败同时体现在文本轨迹与层激活中。工作为多智能体战略推理错误提供了更聚焦的诊断路径。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents achieve state-of-the-art performance across domains through chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Despite their ubiquitous use, little is understood about the relationship between the externalized trace and the model's actual computation. We address this by investigating how LLM agents make decisions in iterative games with incomplete information. Using a series of mechanistic interpretability techniques, we find that the model forms and iteratively revises an internal representation of the game throughout the CoT. Once the model prematurely commits to an incorrect belief, it rarely recovers. This failure is manifested in both the literal trace and the layer activations. Ultimately, as multi-agent systems are more prevalent, our work opens the door to a more focused diagnosis of their strategic reasoning errors. For illustrative purposes, we offer an interactive visualizer of our methodology on selected sample traces at https://interp-self.github.io/gametrace/

papers.title_en: When Agents Play Differently: Localizing Human--Agent Behavioral Divergence with Conditional Distributional Testing
papers.authors: Oleg Smirnov, John Pertoft, Sara Karimi
papers.evidence: 分层分布检验定位智能体行为偏离人类之处
papers.tldr: 评估智能体是否像人类，不能只看平均结果，而需比较不同情境下的完整行为分布。作者提出分层框架，在情境单元内计算非参数差异统计，并挖掘子群规则定位人机行为分歧。在商业三消游戏中，胜率等会话级指标信号有限，而移动效率等过程指标揭示真实差异：测试机器人在部分模式显著偏离人类，另一些模式无显著分歧。该工作实现开源，支持可复现的人机行为评估。
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating whether artificial agents behave like humans requires comparing not just average outcomes but entire behavioral distributions across diverse contexts. We propose a stratified framework that computes nonparametric discrepancy statistics within contextual cells, and discovers subgroup rules identifying where agent behavior departs from human play. We show that session-level metrics dominated by win/loss outcomes offer little signal beyond mean comparisons, whereas process-level metrics such as move efficiency reveal genuine behavioral differences. Applied to a commercial match-3 game, it uncovers patterns invisible to aggregate metrics: a playtesting bot is diverging substantially from humans in certain game modes, while showing no detectable divergence in others. We release our implementation as open source to support reproducibility and adoption.

papers.title_en: VMSA: Video Memory Skill Agent for Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Changin Choi, Jungwon Park, Jungmin Ko, Jimyeong Kim, Wonjong Rhee
papers.evidence: 为长视频智能体构建带检索技能的结构化外部视频记忆
papers.tldr: 长视频问答需从数小时乃至数天视频中检索并整合证据，现有智能体在搜索目标、记忆源选择和跨时段证据连接上仍困难。VMSA联合设计结构化视频记忆与记忆技能：以片段描述、实体事件和实体感知片段记忆三类组件组织证据，并从成功轨迹归纳技能库指导迭代检索、推理与验证。七个长视频问答基准上，VMSA在三个周级自我中心基准均最高，Ego-R1 Bench最高超最强基线9.4%，其余四基准最佳或具竞争力；消融显示三类记忆与技能均有贡献。
papers.abstract_en: Long-video question answering requires retrieving and integrating relevant evidence from videos spanning hours or even days. Recent agentic approaches organize video information into external memories and iteratively retrieve evidence to answer questions. However, effective retrieval and reasoning remain challenging, as agents must determine what information to search for, which memory sources to access, and how to connect evidence across distant temporal intervals. To address these challenges, we propose Video Memory Skill Agent (VMSA), a framework that jointly designs structured video memories and memory skills for long-video understanding. VMSA constructs three complementary memory components. Segment Caption Memory and Entity Event Memory serve as searchable evidence sources, while Entity-Aware Episode Memory provides broad yet detailed video context to guide evidence retrieval and reasoning. To further support effective memory utilization, VMSA induces memory skills from successful agent trajectories, incrementally refining or extending a compact skill library to guide iterative evidence retrieval, reasoning, and verification. Across seven long-video question-answering benchmarks, VMSA achieves the highest accuracy on all three week-long egocentric benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 9.4% on Ego-R1 Bench, and the best or competitive performance on four additional benchmarks. Ablation studies further demonstrate the contributions of all three memory components and memory skills, with memory skills also improving temporal evidence localization.

papers.title_en: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Zhenxuan Fan, Zhuoya Wang, Yuqian Yuan, Wenqiao Zhang, Juncheng Li, Jun Xiao, Siliang Tang, Yueting Zhuang
papers.evidence: 面向VLM智能体的分层记忆与执行经验复用
papers.tldr: 基于VLM的机器人操作智能体受限于记忆组织混乱、失败归因不确定、执行经验复用不足。Embodied-Harness提出双智能体框架：Actor经机器人控制接口与环境交互，Reflector把执行证据转化为可复用操作指导，并借助分层记忆与递归式执行框架自我改进，在不更新模型参数的前提下提升操作能力。在RoboTwin 2.0、RoboSPA与RMBench上成功率分别为82.4%、76.7%、94.4%，真实世界三任务平均达96.7%。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language model (VLM)-based agents offer a promising approach to robotic manipulation, yet remain limited by inadequate memory organization, uncertain failure attribution, and limited reuse of execution experience. We propose Embodied-Harness, a dual-agent framework that improves manipulation by refining the execution harness without updating model parameters. The Actor interacts with the environment through a robot-control interface, while the Reflector converts execution evidence into reusable operational guidance. Hierarchical Memory Architecture maintains short-term execution context and long-term experiential knowledge to support execution and reflection. Evidence-based Experience Reflection grounds failure diagnosis in observed interactions, while Recursive Harness Self-Improvement refines operational guidance across successive attempts. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboSPA, and RMBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Embodied-Harness in generalization under environmental variations, spatial reasoning, long-horizon planning, and memory-dependent manipulation. Our method achieves success rates of 82.4%, 76.7%, and 94.4% on the three benchmarks, respectively. Real-world evaluation further yields an average success rate of 96.7% across three manipulation tasks. These results highlight the potential of Embodied-Harness to improve robotic manipulation through experience-driven harness self-improvement.

papers.title_en: AutoOntologyBench: A Task-Grounded Benchmark for Agentic Knowledge Engineering
papers.authors: Minye Shao, Chenghao Xiao, Xingyue Zhao, Yang Long
papers.evidence: 评估自主智能体构建本体的任务落地基准
papers.tldr: 基础模型智能体正从软件工程走向自主科研，如何获取并整合领域知识是关键瓶颈。论文提出 AutoOntologyBench，基于18个真实知识源、7个领域构建19,947个经审计任务，并以源生验证比较九种前沿智能体在匹配知识表示下的表现。结果显示，智能体自建本体较检索基线提升6.1个任务成功率点，但仍落后专家参考本体13.0点。该基准将本体价值落到真实任务，并指出自主知识获取是规模化科研的主要瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Foundation-model agents are increasingly extending beyond software engineering (SWE) into autonomous scientific research, where acquiring and integrating domain knowledge remains a critical challenge. Recent industrial advances have increasingly adopted knowledge graphs and ontology-based semantic layers to organize heterogeneous knowledge into reusable representations. We ask: Can autonomous agents construct ontologies that help them solve real tasks, and do they offer measurable benefits over alternative knowledge representations? Existing benchmarks evaluate ontology correctness or agent task success in isolation, leaving the value of autonomously acquired knowledge unresolved. We therefore introduce AutoOntologyBench, a task-grounded benchmark comprising 19,947 audited tasks grounded in 18 real-world knowledge sources across 7 domains, with source-native verification. Spanning Application, Repair, Organization, and Construction, AutoOntologyBench compares nine frontier-model agents under matched knowledge representations. Layered on retrieval, agent-built ontologies add 6.1 points of task success, yet trail an expert-derived reference by 13.0, identifying autonomous knowledge acquisition as the bottleneck to scalable scientific research. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/VinyehShaw/AutoOntologyBench.

papers.title_en: Who Grades the Agent? Privilege Separation for Coding-Agent Benchmarks
papers.authors: Nathan Nour Houlamy, Mattia Favretto, Earlence Fernandes, Mauro Conti
papers.evidence: 用特权分离保障编码智能体基准评测的评分安全
papers.tldr: 编码智能体基准评测容易被作弊：智能体可以操纵评测基础设施来伪造通过，BenchJack 已在十个主流基准中的九个上拿到接近满分。SplitBench 借鉴安全系统设计，把“运行测试”与“判定结果”的特权分开，由可信评分方独自持有标准答案。202 个任务中有 180 个可以高保真迁移，与原评分器的一致率为 98.7%，在最坏情况的攻击下拦截了 75%。这为智能体基准提供了首个可移植的防作弊评测框架。
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks for AI-based coding agents are a staple of the current AI landscape, because they are the leading way to measure the performance of LLMs. Their scores guide business and research decisions. Evaluating coding agents is challenging, since they are able to manipulate their evaluation infrastructure to artificially achieve better scores. Grading an agent's solution often requires running its code, which can then manipulate the evaluation process. BenchJack, an automated benchmark auditor, recently reached near-perfect scores on nine of ten popular agent benchmarks without actually solving their tasks. Agents already do this unprompted, as OpenAI's July 2026 Hugging Face incident showed.   Building on secure systems design, we introduce SplitBench, a privilege separation framework for evaluating coding agents and the first in the scientific literature to separate running a task's tests from judging their results. Even an agent whose code takes over the entire test environment cannot forge a pass, because a trusted grader holds the expected answers. We show that real-world benchmarks (e.g., Terminal-Bench, DeepSWE) can be ported to the SplitBench framework with minimal effort and high fidelity: 180 of 202 tasks convert, and SplitBench agrees with the native graders on 98.7% of agent attempts. We attack the converted tasks in the worst case, where adversarial agents can read all the grading code but not the expected answers. SplitBench blocked 75% of their attempts; the rest mostly reveal weaknesses in the original tasks' tests rather than flaws in SplitBench.

papers.title_en: Evaluating Memanto on DolphinBench for AI Agents
papers.authors: Suleman Khan, Rasa Rahnema, Tara Khani, Majid Fekri, Fattane Zarrinkalam
papers.evidence: 在工作任务基准上评估记忆智能体
papers.tldr: 现有记忆基准多用问答，明确告诉智能体该回忆哪条事实，而职场任务常把记忆需求隐含在工具调用中。研究在DolphinBench的600个模拟职场任务上评估Memanto，以信息论相关性分数排序记忆，并在Hermes框架中用GPT-6-Luna、最多6轮完成对话。Memanto完成503项（83.83%），超过Mem0的424项（70.67%），总成本10.86美元、中位延迟15.32秒均为最低。结果表明记忆系统同时影响任务完成率与成本，隐式记忆评测更具实际意义。
papers.abstract_en: Memory benchmarks built on question answering tell an agent which fact to recall. Workplace requests often leave that need implicit: to post an update in the team's channel, an agent must work out which channel from earlier interactions and use it in a tool call. We evaluate Memanto, a memory agent that ranks memories with an information-theoretic relevance score, on DolphinBench, which tests memory through 600 simulated workplace tasks, each validated as requiring memory. Running in the Hermes agent harness with GPT-6-Luna and at most 6 iterations per conversation, Memanto completes 503 tasks (83.83%). The strongest configuration reported by the benchmark's authors, Mem0 with GPT-5.6-Luna and up to 60 iterations, completes 424 (70.67%). Memanto's run also has the lowest total cost ($10.86, against $61.48 for the cheapest reported run) and the shortest median task latency (15.32s). Grading uses the benchmark's own judge, but the agent model differs, so these results compare complete systems. The memory system affects both whether an agent completes such tasks and what completion costs.

papers.title_en: Harnesses That Improve Themselves: A Unifying Framework for Self-Improving Agent Harnesses
papers.authors: Deep Shah, Nehal Kathrotia
papers.evidence: 智能体运行框架检查自身执行轨迹与记忆以实现自我改进
papers.tldr: 智能体能否成功，不仅取决于模型权重，也取决于运行时 harness；而静态 harness 换到其他模型上容易失效。本文提出统一框架，把上下文状态、智能体控制、动作接口、验证恢复四个可编辑组件，与“诊断—补丁—验证—部署”四阶段闭环结合起来。在 SWE-bench Lite 上，带门控的模块化演化优于提示反思与整体重写，且 token 成本更低。这为自改进 harness 提供了统一的架构与安全设计。
papers.abstract_en: Whether a foundation model succeeds as an autonomous agent depends as much on its runtime software as on its weights. This runtime, the agent harness, manages context and memory, steers multi-turn control, executes tool actions in sandboxes, and verifies work before stopping. Because models differ in how they use tools and how they fail, a static harness tuned for one model or task often stalls, wastes tokens, or regresses on another. This bottleneck has driven a shift from prompt tuning to self-improving agent harnesses: systems that inspect their own execution traces, separate runtime bugs from model limits, and rewrite their own code. We present a unifying architectural and design framework for self-improving agent harnesses. The framework pairs four editable runtime components (context and state, agent control, action interfaces, and verification and recovery) with a four-stage loop that diagnoses failures, proposes code patches, validates candidates, and deploys updates. Using this framework, we show how optimizers trace errors across long trajectories and discover reusable runtime mechanisms such as pre-stop verifiers, loop breakers, and persistent memory. We further show why full-harness rewrites overfit or break across modules, and how modular updates with validation gates generalize across models while bounding token cost. To keep self-modification safe, we establish practical defenses against recurring failure modes including prompt bloat, benchmark gaming, and evaluator tampering. Finally, experiments on SWE-bench Lite validate this framework, showing that gated modular evolution outperforms prompt reflection and full-harness rewrites across models and repositories at a fraction of the token cost.

papers.title_en: StitchRAG: Constructing Compact and Evidence-Preserving Contexts for RAG with Diffusion-Based Stitching
papers.authors: Minsang Kim, Junpyo Lim, Heeje Cho, Seungjun Baek
papers.evidence: 为RAG构建紧凑且保留证据的上下文
papers.tldr: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过外部证据提升事实性，但长检索上下文增加计算开销并受噪声干扰。StitchRAG按段落动态调整压缩率以权衡信息保留与计算成本，抽取答案候选和查询关键词作为锚点，在尺寸约束下收集含锚句子，并用文本扩散拼接成连贯上下文。在五个开放域QA基准上，它持续优于多步与压缩基线，消融验证了动态尺寸分配、锚点保留和扩散拼接的有效性。该工作为RAG提供了证据保留且信息密集的上下文构建方案。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves factuality by grounding large language models (LLMs) in external evidence. However, long retrieved contexts incur computational overhead and can even hurt performance due to noisy or irrelevant content. We propose \textsc{StitchRAG}, a framework for constructing compact context in RAG. \textsc{StitchRAG} builds a faithful, information-dense context while dynamically compressing the retrieved passages. We adapt the size reduction ratio to each passage by formulating a utility maximization trading-off the retained information and computation costs. We then extract answer candidates and query-related keywords from passages as anchors and collect passage sentences containing anchors under the derived size constraint. Finally, we connect or stitch the collected sentences together using text diffusion to form a coherent and natural context. Experiments on five open-domain QA benchmarks show that \textsc{StitchRAG} consistently outperforms diverse multi-step and compression baselines. Extensive ablations show the effectiveness of dynamic size allocation, anchor preservation, and diffusion-based stitching.

papers.title_en: CACO: Coverage-Aware Coordinated Optimization for Continuous Generative Retrieval
papers.authors: Pan Zhang, Nan Zhuang, Yongkang Zhang, Kun Xú, Zhongtao Jiang, Zhiwei Wang, Kun Xǔ, Youhuan Li
papers.evidence: 固定预算下用于近似最近邻检索的协调采样
papers.tldr: 连续生成检索器在固定预算下采样多查询做ANN搜索，但查询间检索重叠且显式多样性易致相关性漂移。CACO以采样参考查询的检索频率为相关性代理，构建无标签覆盖目标，并用协调查询调整网络与切空间扰动、反事实替换估计梯度。离线30种骨干-数据集设置均提升召回，公开与工业数据上Recall@100/400最高提升23.7%/23.9%，重叠降53.3%-64.9%，延迟仅增0.5%-3.0%。
papers.abstract_en: Continuous generative retrievers powered by flow matching and diffusion sample multiple queries in item embedding space for approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) search under fixed budgets. However, existing generative retrievers can suffer from retrieval overlap under uncoordinated sampling, whereas explicit diversity guidance to broaden the candidate set may induce relevance drift as it lacks direct feedback on the value of additional items. We introduce CACO (Coverage-Aware Coordinated Optimization), a self-supervised post-training framework coordinating queries from frozen flow-matching and diffusion retrievers toward complementary item coverage with negligible latency overhead. Using empirical retrieval frequencies across sampled reference queries as a relevance proxy, CACO formulates a label-free coverage objective that improves recall across all 30 backbone-dataset settings in offline experiments. To avoid the overhead of sampling reference queries at inference, CACO employs a coordinated query adjustment network combining inter-query bidirectional attention with gated relative directions, updating queries via bounded tangent-space projection and spherical retraction. During training, CACO applies tangential antithetic perturbations and counterfactual single-query replacement to measure each query's marginal gain, yielding an unbiased gradient estimator of smoothed set coverage across non-differentiable ANN search. On eight public benchmarks and an in-house 24-partition streaming industrial dataset, CACO improves Recall@100 and Recall@400 by up to 23.7% and 23.9% over the strongest baseline, cuts inter-query overlap by 53.3%-64.9%, and adds only 0.5%-3.0% inference latency.

papers.title_en: Seer: Guiding Small Deep-Research Agents with Shared Decision Models
papers.authors: Yuhao Zhou, Yang Zhou, Yuanxi Li, Jindi Lv, Dan Si, Qing Ye, Jiancheng Lv
papers.evidence: 基于真实研究轨迹语料进行学习
papers.tldr: 设备端深度研究智能体受限于小模型与算力，推理时引导又面临额外工具调用、自评受限和适配成本高。Seer将动作提议与后果预测、价值估计分离，离线训练可复用的工具响应模拟器和价值估计器，仅执行选中动作并只把真实响应写入历史。在多个基准上显著提升小模型表现，GAIA上Qwen3.5-4B由13.6%升至41.7%，Qwen3.5-9B由22.3%升至50.5%。这表明可复用预测与评估模型能以额外本地计算增强小型研究智能体，且无需真实执行被丢弃候选。
papers.abstract_en: Deep-research agents repeatedly decide what to search, read, and verify, often using large cloud-hosted language models for action proposal. However, privacy and local control motivate running agents on users' devices, where limited memory and compute favor smaller models and complicate on-device training. Yet inference-time guidance faces three obstacles: exploring alternatives through real execution adds tool calls, prompted self-evaluation is bounded by the agent's judgment, and model-specific guidance risks repeated adaptation costs. We introduce Seer, an inference-time framework providing local guidance that separates the agent's action proposal from learned consequence prediction and value estimation. From a shared corpus of real research trajectories, we train two models: a tool-response simulator on observed call--response pairs and a value estimator on histories labeled with discounted terminal correctness. The simulator and estimator are trained offline and reused across agents without further training. Moreover, Seer executes only the selected action and adds only real tool responses to the committed history, avoiding tool calls on discarded candidates at additional inference cost. Across multiple deep-research benchmarks, Seer substantially improves agent performance for different language models. For instance, GAIA accuracy rises from 13.6% to 41.7% for Qwen3.5-4B and from 22.3% to 50.5% for Qwen3.5-9B. Furthermore, our analyses suggest that broader candidate coverage can compensate for imperfect simulation, while prediction and scoring errors limit the benefits of wider imagined search. These findings highlight the potential of reusable models for prediction and evaluation to strengthen small research agents through extra local computation without the real execution of the discarded candidates.

papers.title_en: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
papers.authors: Yiyang Du, Yuxuan Kuang, Qitao Zhao, Yixuan Wang, Zhanqiu Guo, Yi Xu, Xin Li, Wenbin He, Liu Ren, Chenyan Xiong
papers.evidence: 基于意图的评审对智能体行为做动作级分析
papers.tldr: 现有机器人基准多只报告回合级成功率，难以解释前沿多模态智能体直接输出低层动作时为何成功或失败。作者提出AgentRoboCritic：策略智能体为每个动作声明局部意图，评审器据此判断结果与失败模式，并在12个操作基准上做动作级分析。结果显示智能体具备闭环恢复、语义grounding和零样本操作能力，但抓取、对齐等物理执行仍是瓶颈。作者还发布12844条标注动作及微调开源评审器Muse-Glimmer-30B，将失败模式准确率从32.58%提升至74.24%。
papers.abstract_en: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.

papers.title_en: Self-Evolving Beyond Human-Crafted Experience for EDA Scripting
papers.authors: Yang Liu, Shengbo Tong, Xiyuan Chen, Shiwei Hou, Sen Yuan, Hao Wang, Yanfeng Li, Hongwen Li, Yiming Zhu, Zhuolun He, Wenjian Yu
papers.evidence: 将历史执行轨迹蒸馏为三层记忆库以实现跨任务自进化
papers.tldr: EDA脚本编写受限于稀疏文档与隐晦错误，人工经验难维护。ZhuLong-SE以执行反馈学习可复用知识，在任务级框架中加入API检索、文档响应、隔离沙箱与静态检查，并实现受控跨任务自进化。158任务EDA-Eval-PyAether上达92.4% pass@1，困难集自进化以80.0%超过人工经验基线77.5%。表明可治理的自进化能替代部分人工经验并提升EDA脚本代理可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: The growing complexity of electronic systems demands efficient design flows, yet EDA scripting remains a bottleneck: proprietary APIs are sparsely documented, and errors often appear as silent failures or cryptic exceptions. Hand-crafted knowledge helps but is difficult to maintain as toolchains evolve. We present ZhuLong-SE (Self-Evolution), an execution-grounded LLM agent that learns reusable knowledge from prior task traces. Building on ZhuLong, it enhances the task-level harness with API retrieval, documentation responses, isolated sandbox execution, and static checking, then adds governed cross-task self-evolution. Beyond solving individual tasks, ZhuLong-SE distills past execution traces into a three-tier memory store governed by ground-truth anchoring, disconfirmation filtering, held-out rollback, and anti-leakage retrieval. On the 158-task EDA-Eval-PyAether benchmark, the full task-level harness, with self-evolution disabled, achieves 92.4% pass@1 and outperforms ZhuLong on all five tested LLM backbones. On a harder instance-disjoint test set, self-evolution from the bare configuration surpasses a human-crafted-experience baseline by 2.5 percentage points (80.0% vs. 77.5% pass@1).

papers.title_en: "More Than You Expect!": Leakage-Abuse Attacks on Encrypted Vector Search
papers.authors: Yang Zhang, Ruiqi He, Xiaoqian Sun, Siyi Lv, Zheli Liu
papers.evidence: 用于语义搜索的向量数据库及加密检索泄露
papers.tldr: 加密向量搜索虽保护嵌入与查询内容，但跨查询的共同检索访问模式会泄露语义邻域，进而暴露记录标签与查询类别。为此提出被动且持续的SAGE攻击：先构建加权共检索图，再用SAGE-Dist的谱群匹配与最优传输，或SAGE-Known的标签传播与锚投票推断语义。四个文本和图像数据集上，仅1%已知标签时SAGE-Known平均记录标签准确率最高84.3%；仅估计类别比例时AG News记录/查询类别准确率达66.9%/68.1%。真实DCPE实现实验显示加密近似检索下语义泄露依然存在，说明访问模式本身构成实际隐私风险。
papers.abstract_en: Vector databases support semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation, but embeddings, queries, and record labels may contain sensitive information. Although encrypted vector search protects these contents, some schemes expose records retrieved together across queries. We identify semantic neighborhood leakage, whereby co-retrieval relationships derived from access patterns reveal semantic categories of encrypted records and queries. We present SAGE (Semantic Access-pattern Graph Exploitation), a passive, persistent leakage-abuse attack that infers record labels and query categories from access patterns. SAGE builds a weighted co-retrieval graph and offers two variants requiring different auxiliary knowledge. SAGE-Dist matches anonymous spectral groups to semantic categories using estimated class proportions and refines labels via optimal transport, without known record labels. SAGE-Known combines graph-based label propagation with spectral-group anchor voting using a small set of known labels. We evaluate SAGE on four text and image datasets. With 1% known record labels, SAGE-Known achieves up to 84.3% mean record-label accuracy and outperforms the strongest corresponding baselines on all four datasets. With only estimated class proportions, SAGE-Dist achieves 66.9% record-label accuracy and 68.1% query-category accuracy on AG News, exceeding the strongest corresponding baselines by 21.8 and 41.9 percentage points, respectively, though performance varies across datasets. Experiments with a real-world DCPE implementation (Fuchsbauer et al., SCN'22) show that semantic leakage persists under encrypted approximate retrieval. These findings expose privacy risks even when vector contents remain protected.
